_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Search open data by kind

description: Search every licence-clean source of one kind at once (jobs, papers and books as work, posts, apps, media, entities, metrics) and get de-duplicated rows. Costs 1 credit per source searched, at most 8. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

platforms.description: Optional: only these platforms, such as ["arxiv", "openalex"].

name: data_search
title: Search open data by kind
